name: Who speaks is measured, then read
what: One timbre model per voice says who speaks each word; the turns are then read and fixed by hand where the model is wrong.
when: Every call; both voices at 90 % or more held out.
why: Asked to show the two voices; never guessed from the words alone or from the picture.
doc: SKILL.md § 2. Who speaks when

name: A word said over the other voice gets its own line
what: A word said over the other voice (an « Absolutely. » under a sentence) is a turn of its own, with its own line in the record.
when: Whenever the model gives such a word to the louder voice.
doc: SKILL.md § 2. Who speaks when

name: Onsets measured on the envelope
what: Each word is moved onto its syllable attack; where two transcription passes disagree on a word that matters, it is read on the envelope and pinned.
when: Every call, for the first word of a turn, the hook's words, punches, the payoff, chips and the riser's word.
why: Whisper put words up to 0.9 s early on the reference; the two passes disagreed on 58 words.
doc: SKILL.md § 3. The onsets

name: The most suspenseful line as the hook
what: The call opens on its most suspenseful line, a complete sentence of 2.5-5 s, ideally the other voice challenging the caller; not the pitch, not a greeting.
when: Every call.
why: Asked to open on a highlight, the moment with the most suspense.

name: Hook glitch on the stressed words
what: On the hook's 3 or 4 stressed words the picture and lettering split red and cyan, bands tear, blocks jump, the camera jolts to 1.035; clean between.
when: Always on the hook; this style has no old-radio bonus.
why: Asked for an effect of its own on the highlight.

name: Hook ends after its last syllable

name: The ringing sheet

when: Between the hook and the call, 2.18 s of output.
why: Asked for a transition where the phone rings, as if we were calling, then bam.

name: Synthesised ringback tone
what: A ringback tone of 440 + 480 Hz (a 0.80 s tone, 0.38 s of silence, the start of the next) that ends on the bam.
when: Under the ringing sheet.
